def factor_overnight_intraday_dissonance_median(df):
    """Smoothed signed square-root overnight-intraday dissonance using a 5-day rolling median for outlier robustness."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight, intraday = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    overnight = overnight.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    intraday = intraday.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    signed_sqrt_overnight = np.sign(overnight) * np.sqrt(np.abs(overnight))
    signed_sqrt_intraday = np.sign(intraday) * np.sqrt(np.abs(intraday))
    raw = signed_sqrt_overnight - signed_sqrt_intraday
    smooth = raw.rolling(5, min_periods=1).median()
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_dissonance_median"] = smooth.fillna(0.0)
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_dissonance_median"]
description: Preserves the parent's overnight-intraday dissonance mechanism: a signed square-root difference between overnight/global and intraday/local return components. The parent's raw daily point estimate is noisy and weakens IC/ICIR. This mutation replaces the raw point with a 5-day rolling median of the same signed-square-root dissonance, reducing sensitivity to single-day outliers and persistent transient gaps while retaining the exact cross-sectional economic signal. The median is a monotone robust smoother, improving RankIC/ICIR stability without changing the sign or economic meaning. No cross-sectional transform is used because the raw signal remains continuous and the parent's successful elite descendant also kept transform none; evidence shows trailing smoothing is sufficient.
